Class Board

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Model.Board.Board
All Implemented Interfaces:
WidgetTUIGenerator
Direct Known Subclasses:
BoardLevel2, BoardTestFlight
public abstract class Board extends Object implements WidgetTUIGenerator
Abstract base class for board management, including board creation, player movement, validation, and elimination. Subclasses provide implementations for building specific board types based on the current game level.

    • eliminatePlayer

      public Board eliminatePlayer(Player player) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Eliminates a player from the board. If the player is present in the list of active players, they are removed, marked as eliminated, and added to the list of eliminated players.
      Parameters:
      player - the player to be eliminated
      Returns:
      the current board instance after the player has been eliminated
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the specified player is not in the list of active players

    • addCell

      protected Cell addCell(int idx)
      Adds a new cell at the specified index and links it into the circular doubly-linked list of existing cells. If the list is empty, the new cell becomes the head. New cells are always appended at the end of the current list.
      Parameters:
      idx - the index to assign to the newly added cell
      Returns:
      the newly created cell

    • buildBoard

      public abstract void buildBoard()
      Abstract method responsible for constructing the board. It builds the complete board structure, including its size and initial cells, based on the specific type of board required for the current game level.

    • addPlayerToBoard

      public void addPlayerToBoard(Player player)
      Adds the given player to the first available initial cell on the board. This method is synchronized to ensure thread safety when multiple clients attempt to join the board simultaneously.
      Parameters:
      player - the player to be added to the board

    • movePlayerForward

      public void movePlayerForward(Player player, int steps)
      Moves the given player forward by the specified number of steps from their current cell. Occupied cells encountered along the movement are skipped.
      Parameters:
      player - the player to be moved
      steps - the number of steps to move the player forward

    • movePlayerBackward

      public void movePlayerBackward(Player player, int steps)

      Parameters:

      steps - the number of steps to move the player forward

    • validatePlayersPosition

      public List<String> validatePlayersPosition()
      Checks the players' cursors to identify any doubled players and eliminate them. Also resets the player list to maintain the correct turn order.
      Returns:
      A list containing the nicknames of the players eliminated
